{{Vanilla|Pointed Dripstone}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''speleothem''' is a pointed cave formation that hangs from ceilings and rises from floors. It is the vanilla {{MCW|Pointed Dripstone|pointed dripstone}} under a new name; the full block it grows from is renamed [[flowstone]]. It behaves exactly as in vanilla ''Minecraft'': it deals extra fall damage to anything that lands on it, falls when the block above it is broken, and drips lava or water into a [[cauldron]] placed below it.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
Speleothems generate in dripstone caves and grow from flowstone that has water above it, as in vanilla. 
=== Trading ===
The [[Engineer]]'s master-level Geothermal Bundle contains 4 speleothems, along with flowstone, lava buckets, cauldrons and glass for building a lava farm.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/armorer/5/lava_kit.json}}</ref> See [[Flowstone#Trading]].

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Four speleothems craft into a block of flowstone, as in vanilla.
